response: "When FBI operative Rachel Jenkins is sent back in time to the early 1960s, she finds herself in the midst of a decades-old nightmare. A time-hopping serial killer, known only as 'The Archon,' has been leaving a trail of bodies across the country, and Rachel's unique knowledge of modern forensic science is the only hope for catching him. With the help of a local detective, Jack Harris, Rachel must use her expertise to leave clues that will lead her modern colleagues back in time to prevent The Archon's next kill. But as the stakes grow higher, Rachel realizes that she's not just fighting to solve a crime - she's fighting to survive in a world where the rules of time and space no longer apply.
